transcript:
Agent: Hi! Quick question — I'm vegetarian 
User: Welcome to Boardwalk Beer Garden. 
Agent: and gluten-free, and my friend's vegan. Do you have options for us, or should we eat beforehand? I know, I'm that friend. But I promise I'm nice about it!
User: No worries at all. I love a friend who asks. I'll have a team member from Boardwalk Beer Garden reach out to you all the details about our gluten free and vegan options. If you'd like, I can also send you our menu right now so you can take a peek. Would you like that? 
Agent: Thank you! Yes, I’d love to see the menu if you can send it over.While I have you, could you maybe give me a quick rundown of what your vegetarian and vegan entrees are called? And do you have any gluten-free options, like buns or a dedicated fryer? 

Also, what’s your most popular dish overall — what do people come for? And just so I can give my friends a heads up, what’s the price range for entrees (cheapest, most expensive, and what’s average)? 

Sorry for the rapid-fire questions — I just want to make sure everyone’s covered!
User: No need to apologize at all. I totally get wanting to make sure everyone's happy. I'm sending you our menu right now, so check your phone for the link. For the rest of your questions, a team member from Boardwalk Beer Garden will reach out to you directly with all the details about vegetarian, vegan, and gluten free options. As well as info on our most popular dishes and entree prices. That way, you'll get the most accurate and up to date info straight from the source. There anything else I can help with while you're here? 
Agent: Thank you, I really appreciate it! I’ll keep an eye out for the menu link.

Just to double-check, is the menu online exactly the same as what you serve in person, or are there any specials or late-night items that aren’t listed? And do you have a kids’ menu or smaller portions for anyone who’s not super hungry?

If you happen to know any dish names off the top of your head (especially for vegetarian, vegan, or gluten-free), I’d love to hear them! But I totally get if you want to leave it to the team member — I know I’m asking a lot. Thanks again for being so helpful!
User: Check your phone. I'm sending that over now. You're not allowed at all. I'm glad you're asking. I've just sent you the menu link. So you'll have the full list to browse. For the most accurate info on specials, late night items, and specific vegetarian, vegan, or gluten free dishes, a team member from Boardwalk Beer Garden will reach out to you directly. We do have a kids menu with tasty options like chicken tenders, mac and cheese bites, corn fritters, french fries, and more perfect for smaller appetites. If you need anything else or wanna book a table, just let me know. 
Agent: Thank you so much! I’ll check out the menu link now. And thanks for confirming about the kids’ menu — that’s super helpful.

I’ll keep an eye out for the team member’s message about the vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options, as well as any specials or late-night items. I know I’m a little high-maintenance with the questions, but you’ve been really patient — thank you!

If I think of anything else, I’ll reach out. Otherwise, I’ll wait to hear from your team.Have a great day!
User: Thank you so much for all the info and for being such a thoughtful planner. See you soon.
